figurative_meaning_en: one after another, in sequence or successively
example_sentences_in_bangla: তারা এক-এক করে সবাই এসে উপস্থিত হলো।
example_sentences_in_english: They arrived one by one at the event.
The books must be read one by one.
note: This is a common reduplicative form in Bengali for expressing succession; synonymous with 'একে একে'.
